question: A can complete 40% of a work in 6 days and B can complete 33(1)/(3)% of the same work in 8 days. They work together for 8 days. C alone completes the remaining work in 4 days. A and C together will complete the same work in:
solution:
**Given:**

A can do 40% of work in 6 days

B can do 331over3 % of the work in 8 days.

**Concept Used:**

Work done = Efficiency × Time taken

**Calculation:**

A can do 40% of work in 6 days

⇒ While A can do the whole work alone in 6over40 × 100

⇒ 15 days ------(1) 

B does 1/3 part of the work in 8 days

⇒ B will do the whole work in (8 × 3) days

⇒ 24 days -------(2)

Now from eq (1) and (2), we can have 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d1e097fd6d44968869479d3887ae491055836d37c156784d2d089f5b040f2c0f.png] 

A and B worked for 8 days

⇒ Worked done by A and B in 8 days= (8 + 5) × 8 units

⇒ 104 Units

Remaining Work = (120 - 104) = 16 Units

C efficiency = 16/4 = 4

Efficiency of (A + C) = 8 + 4 = 12

So, (A + C) together complete the work in = 120/12 = 10 days

**∴ A & C together complete the same work in 10 days.**
